name: PARKOUR Legacy
desc:
Explore an expansive city, level up and unlock new gear, all while perfecting your parkour skills along the way!

Please read the help by pressing H, as this game can be very unforgiving for new players. Taking the time to learn about the mechanics will greatly improve your experience.

Join the A Mongoose Studio community for a free 1.2x in-game points multiplier: https://www.roblox.com/communities/3468086

Enjoying PARKOUR Legacy? Check out the sequel, PARKOUR Reborn: https://www.roblox.com/games/11639495622

Notice: Playing our game with any executor, injector, or modification to your Roblox client will result in a permanent ban.
